title: Seasonal banner slides for April Fools' Day and Wireshark's birthday
description:
Replace the old "Sniffing the glue" welcome page easter egg with
proper banner slides using the new BannerSeasonal slide type. This
type cannot be used from slides.json — it exists only for hardcoded
seasonal content.

AI-Assisted: yes (Claude Code)

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass

Is it possible to start moving this functionality to a more polymorphic approach between Wireshark and "other applications" (i.e. Stratoshark).  I've been trying to remove application_flavor_is_wireshark() (handling it in subclasses that can be application specific) and I think you're familiar enough with Qt that it can be done "properly" the first time.

I agree with the sentiment, but I really dont think that for a function that exists for just one time we should do the overload. Rather could we add it to a json if required. I would much more prefer to change the texts to a more generic form to avoid the duality at all.

Do we really need to put big banners on our easter eggs?
I would like to keep them obscure.
As do I, but I really could not think of a name that would fit. Any ideas?
I would like all configuration to be in a `.json` file for each info banner, and only generic code to handle them.
